name: codex-sulcus
description: Persistent, intelligent memory for Codex CLI. Gives Codex long-term memory that survives across sessions — thermodynamic decay, knowledge graph, semantic search, and 25 MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Thermodynamic memory that thinks — persistent cross-session recall
interface.longDescription: Sulcus adds persistent, intelligent memory to Codex. Memories decay naturally over time (thermodynamic model), surface via multi-signal recall (semantic + graph + heat), and evolve through an SIU pipeline that auto-classifies, extracts entities, and learns your recall patterns. Includes reactive triggers that fire when memory conditions are met.
